Here is a comprehensive list of **Sherlock Holmes Movies**, organized by era:

## 🎬 Sherlock Holmes Movies – Complete List

---

### 🎞️ Silent Era (1900s–1920s)
Early films like *Sherlock Holmes Baffled* (1900) and *A Study in Scarlet* (1914) introduced Holmes to cinema.

| Year | Movie | Stars |
|------|-------|-------|
| 1900 | *Sherlock Holmes Baffled* | Unknown |
| 1905 | *Adventures of Sherlock Holmes; or, Held for Ransom* | — |
| 1914 | *A Study in Scarlet* | James Bragington |
| 1916 | *Sherlock Holmes* | William Gillette |
| 1922 | *Sherlock Holmes* | John Barrymore |

John Barrymore played the role in a 1922 movie entitled *Sherlock Holmes*, with Roland Young as Watson and William Powell in his first screen appearance.

---

### 🔊 Early Talkies (1929–1937)
Arthur Wontner's series and films like *The Speckled Band* (1931) brought Holmes to the sound era, blending fidelity to the source material with modernized elements.

| Year | Movie | Stars |
|------|-------|-------|
| 1929 | *The Return of Sherlock Holmes* | Clive Brook |
| 1931 | *The Speckled Band* | Raymond Massey |
| 1931 | *The Sleeping Cardinal* | Arthur Wontner |
| 1932 | *Sherlock Holmes* | Clive Brook |
| 1933 | *A Study in Scarlet* | Reginald Owen |
| 1935 | *The Triumph of Sherlock Holmes* | Arthur Wontner |
| 1937 | *Silver Blaze* | Arthur Wontner |

In 1931, Raymond Massey played Sherlock Holmes in his screen debut, *The Speckled Band*, while Arthur Wontner played Holmes in five British films from 1931 to 1937.

---

### 🎩 The Basil Rathbone Era (1939–1946)
A series of fourteen films based on Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's Sherlock Holmes stories was released between 1939 and 1946; the British actors Basil Rathbone and Nigel Bruce played Holmes and Dr. John Watson, respectively. The first two films in the series were produced by 20th Century Fox and released in 1939. Universal Pictures then acquired the rights and produced a further twelve films.

| Year | Movie |
|------|-------|
| 1939 | *The Hound of the Baskervilles* |
| 1939 | *The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes* |
| 1942 | *Sherlock Holmes and the Voice of Terror* |
| 1942 | *Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon* |
| 1943 | *Sherlock Holmes in Washington* |
| 1943 | *Sherlock Holmes Faces Death* |
| 1944 | *The Spider Woman* |
| 1944 | *The Scarlet Claw* |
| 1944 | *The Pearl of Death* |
| 1945 | *The House of Fear* |
| 1945 | *The Woman in Green* |
| 1945 | *Pursuit to Algiers* |
| 1946 | *Terror by Night* |
| 1946 | *Dressed to Kill* |

Basil Rathbone holds the record for portraying Sherlock Holmes in the most feature-length films, starring in 14 movies from 1939 to 1946. His portrayal is considered definitive by many fans.

---

Holmes's adaptations include origin stories like *Young Sherlock Holmes* (1985), a Disneyfication in *The Great Mouse Detective* (1986), and a case of mistaken identity in *Without a Clue* (1988).

In 1991, Charlton Heston played Holmes in the Turner Network Television production of Paul Giovanni's play *The Crucifer of Blood*. 2002 also saw the made-for-television cable movie *Case of Evil*, about a 20-something Sherlock Holmes (James D'Arcy) and a Doctor Watson on the trail of Holmes' archenemy, Professor Moriarty (Vincent D'Onofrio).

### 🎬 Modern Era (2009–Present)

|------|-------|-------|----------|

| 2015 | *Mr. Holmes* | Ian McKellen | Bill Condon |

| 2020 | *Enola Holmes* | Millie Bobby Brown, Henry Cavill | Harry Bradbeer |
| 2022 | *Enola Holmes 2* | Millie Bobby Brown, Henry Cavill | Harry Bradbeer |

*Mr. Holmes* (2015) features an aged, retired Sherlock Holmes dealing with dementia as he tries to remember his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. The film stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney, and Hiroyuki Sanada.

Robert Downey Jr. won a Golden Globe for his display as a dishevelled bohemian Holmes, who is handy with fists and faculties alike.
